content: {"rule":"K-S2","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text does the thing the rule governs by using the absence of a named body/channel in the text as the reason to label the point UNDERDETERMINED.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"the text names the seed of David 'according to the flesh' without naming whose body is the channel, so the point stays open.","rule_words":"That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.","room":"I interpreted 'That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED' as barring a verse's silence from making a point open, not only from making it stand; the contrary reading would allow silence to leave the point open.","why":"The judge's stated ground for UNDERDETERMINED is that the text names the seed 'according to the flesh' without naming whose body is the channel, which is the forbidden use of a verse's nonstatement/silence to leave the point open."}
